intro.title: Zustand Persist Middleware
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Vue app that uses Zustand's persist middleware to save and restore a counter state across browser sessions. You will learn how to configure a Zustand store with persistence, enabling data to survive page refreshes. The core concept involves middleware integration and local storage handling within a state management pattern. You'll work with Vue components, Zustand's create function, and the persist middleware plugin. By the end, you'll understand how to make state persistent in a Vue application using Zustand.
intro.usecase: Zustand's persist middleware is essential for maintaining user preferences and application state across sessions in real-world Vue applications. You'll see this pattern in dashboard applications where users customize their workspace layouts, filter settings, or chart configurations that need to persist between visits. E-commerce sites use it to preserve shopping cart contents and recently viewed items, while analytics platforms maintain user-selected date ranges and visualization preferences. This middleware ensures that when users return to your application, their personalized experience remains intact without requiring server-side storage.
